entries.title: Psalms 29:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Give unto Jehovah, ye sons of the mighty ones, give unto Jehovah glory and strength;

entries.title: Psalms 29:2
segments: Give unto Jehovah the glory of his name; worship Jehovah in holy splendour.

entries.title: Psalms 29:3
segments: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: the *God of glory thundereth, --Jehovah upon great waters.

entries.title: Psalms 29:4
segments: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; the voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.

entries.title: Psalms 29:5
segments: The voice of Jehovah breaketh cedars; yea, Jehovah breaketh the cedars of Lebanon:

entries.title: Psalms 29:6
segments: And he maketh them to skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young buffalo.

entries.title: Psalms 29:7
segments: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth out flames of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 29:8
segments: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

entries.title: Psalms 29:9
segments: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, and layeth bare the forests; and in his temple doth every one say, Glory!

entries.title: Psalms 29:10
segments: Jehovah sitteth upon the flood; yea, Jehovah sitteth as king for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 29:11
segments: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.
